mapper.insert: INSERT INTO operation_log (user_id, username, action, target, method, path, ip, success) VALUES (#{userId}, #{username}, #{action}, #{target}, #{method}, #{path}, #{ip}, #{success})
mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM operation_log
WHERE (username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR action LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR target LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR path LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM operation_log WHERE create_time < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY)
